contentHtml:
We have guaranteed treatment for ovarian cysts. Bleeding if any will stops in few days, pain will disappear in a week’s time and Menstruation become normal.  Normally we admit the patients for 3 weeks.  Our treatment consists of panchakarma plus internal and external medicines.  Patients have to continue the medicines for 6 months to one year.  PCOD is one of the reasons for female infertility.  We have effective treatment for infertility too.
